name: decrypt-after-restart
setup: create a key pair, restart the key-store with the same seed/domain/version, then get the pair
assertions: returned key pair equals the original pair

name: reject-malformed-record
setup: replace a public or secret record with a missing-field or unsupported-version envelope
assertions: get fails with a safe invalid-record error

name: reject-tampered-record
setup: modify public/secret payload, tag, pair metadata, or authenticated identity metadata
assertions: get fails with an integrity error

name: storage-timeout-after-write
setup: make storage unavailable after accepting a pair creation
assertions: the key-store reconciles by reading the record where safe
the caller receives a retryable storage outcome
no secret appears in the error

name: invalid-bootstrap
setup: remove or shorten a public/secret seed, or remove the storage access configuration
assertions: the failure does not expose seed material
